translation:
phrase. 无中文释义
n. X射线
phrase. X光；X射线；透视；洞察力
exampleEn: The doctor took an x-ray to check his broken bone.；The doctor used an x-ray to check his bone.
exampleZh: 医生拍了一张X光片来检查他断裂的骨头。；医生用X光检查了他的骨头。
englishDefinition:
A type of electromagnetic radiation used for medical imaging, often written with a hyphen.；
An X-ray is a type of radiation that can pass through most solid materials. X-rays are used in medicine to make images of the inside of the body.；
A medical imaging technique using radiation.

exampleEn: He showed xenophobia toward people from other countries.
exampleZh: 他对来自其他国家的人表现出恐外心理。
englishDefinition: Xenophobia is a strong feeling of dislike or fear of people from other countries.
mnemonic:
[词根词缀]
phobia—恐惧
xeno—foreign
acrophobia n.恐高症
homophobia n.对同性恋的憎恶（或恐惧)
claustrophobia n.幽闭恐怖

translation: n. 施乐复印机（商标名称）
exampleEn: He used the xerox to copy his resume.
exampleZh: 他用施乐复印机复印了他的简历。
englishDefinition: To make a copy of a document, picture, etc. using a special machine.
mnemonic:
[联想]
x复制x,中间zero变化

duplicate copy

translation: n. 排外的人；对陌生人或外国人恐惧或憎恨的人
exampleEn: He is a xenophobe who hates foreigners.
exampleZh: 他是一个讨厌外国人的排外者。
englishDefinition: A xenophobe is a person who has a strong dislike or fear of people from other countries.
mnemonic:
[联想]
GRE
仇视（或畏惧）外国人（或外国事物）者
【记】xeno外国人, phobe恐惧
xenophobia 排外
xenophilia，xenocentric，xenomania 媚外

exampleEn: He is xenophobic and dislikes foreigners.
exampleZh: 他有排外心理，不喜欢外国人。
englishDefinition: If you describe someone as xenophobic, you disapprove of them because they show strong dislike or fear of people from other countries.
mnemonic:
[辨析]
xeno(外国人)+phobe(恐怖 惧怕)
关于前缀：xeno-外国来的，陌生的，x叉掉no否认掉

claustrophobic 幽闭恐惧症
homophobic 害怕同性恋的
xenophobic 仇外的，排外的
（不同cacophony euphonic）

exampleEn: The X-chromosome is one of the sex chromosomes.
exampleZh: X染色体是性染色体之一。
englishDefinition: The X chromosome is one of the two sex chromosomes in humans (the other is the Y chromosome). The X chromosome in humans spans more than 153 million base pairs (the building material of DNA) and represents about 800 protein-coding genes.
mnemonic:
[词源]
chrom = color,表示“颜色”，som = body,表示“身体”，chromosome"染色体”。

chronic a.长期的，慢性的
chrome谷歌浏览器，铬(多彩)。Chrome谷歌浏览器;化学里称之为“铬”。铬的名称来自希腊文Chroma,意为颜色。因为铬元素以多种不同颜色的化合物存在，故被称为“多彩的元素”，另据说体内铬若能维持到一定水平，就会使你青春常在，所以为“葆你青春的铬”。
charm魔力，魔法
somatic a.肉体的
som身体+atic表形容词-a.肉体的

englishDefinition: A colorless, odorless, inert gaseous element occurring in trace amounts in the atmosphere and used in certain types of electric lamps.
mnemonic:
[联想]
来自希腊语 xenos, 客人，陌生人，其发现者苏格兰化学家 William Ramsay 因这种元素发现困难而命名。比较 krypton,dysprosium.
